newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rosneft meets on Krasnodar refinery next week.
newsitem.headline: Rosneft meets on Krasnodar refinery next week.

text.p: The board of directors of Russian oil company NK Rosneft will meet next week to discuss a threat by a presidential tax commission to begin bankruptcy proceedings against its Krasnodarnefteorgsintez subsidiary.
The Krasnodar refinery was among a group of four companies threatened with bankruptcy by the emergency commission on tax and budget discipline for non-payment of tax arrears.
Management of Rosneft and the Krasnodar refinery decided on Friday to create a working group to prepare a plan to get out of the situation, a Rosneft spokesman said.

The Rosneft spokesman said the refinery was owed nearly half this sum by agricultural producers who had not paid for deliveries of oil. About 45 billion was owed by the Atlas company which is Rosneft's operator in the region and owns 20 percent of the refinery.
